# Mar Torrente - Technical Profile and Project Context

Mar Torrente (full name: Maria del Mar Torrente) is a Digital Entertainment Design Engineer, Technical Artist, Animator, Rigger, and Creative Technologist. 

## Technical Strengths

### Advanced Character Rigging & Technical Art
Eridan is Mar Torrente's strongest technical-art showcase.
It is a fully custom character rig built from scratch without an autorig, engineered in Autodesk Maya and Blender 4.3. 
The rig was designed as a production-oriented animation system rather than a simple bone setup.

Technical systems include:
- IK/FK switching and snapping built via custom Python scripting
- Independent body-part isolation
- Custom animator tweak controls, pole targets, orient constraints, and driven keys
- Automated shoulder and foot systems
- Custom finger controllers
- Squash/stretch systems
- Facial rig combining bones, shape keys, and Bendy Bones
- Lip-sync controls for M/E/A/O/P
- Jaw and mouth systems
- Eye, eyebrow, and ear relationships
- Procedural eye highlight and dart animation
- Procedural breathing
- Clothing and accessory systems
- Goggles space switching
- Geometry Nodes deformation effects
- Custom NPR/Toon shader
- Independent key, fill, and rim lighting
- RGB light-channel mapping
- Proxy meshes for performance
- Unity-compatible deformation workflows

This project demonstrates advanced character technical art, rigging-system design, Python automation, procedural animation, animator-facing tools, shader development, and performance-aware production workflows.

### Portfolio Engineering
The portfolio itself is an interactive software project.

It combines:
- React
- Three.js / WebGL / p5.js
- Clean modular ES6 implementations
- Real-time reactive particle simulations utilizing spatial hashing and Kuramoto oscillator synchronization
- Interactive 3D elements
- Animated UI transitions
- Touch and pointer interaction
- Environmental minigames
- Persistent competitive leaderboard functionality
- Backend Architecture: Browser → Cloudflare Worker → GitHub API
- Responsive and performance-adaptive rendering
- Accessibility and reduced-motion support

The portfolio is intentionally designed as an explorable digital environment rather than a conventional portfolio website.

## Evidence of Technical Complexity
- **Eridan:** Demonstrates advanced character technical art through a custom rigging system built without an autorig, combining Python-driven controls for Maya/Blender 4.3, procedural systems, facial deformation, secondary animation, shader development, and performance optimization.
- **Portfolio Website:** Demonstrates creative coding through React, p5.js, Three.js, reactive WebGL particles powered by spatial hashing, interactive 3D elements, environmental interactions, minigames, a persistent leaderboard infrastructure (Browser → Cloudflare Worker → GitHub API), responsive interaction, and adaptive rendering.
- **Unity Mechanics:** Demonstrates software engineering discipline through C# physics scripting, draggable UI object scale behaviors, and ThreadManager unit testing. 
- **Crónicas del Tonusco:** Demonstrates production-scale interactive development through a ~40-minute AR experience with branching narrative, object recognition, minigames, animation, mocap integration, and Unity/Vuforia programming.
- **Platillo:** Demonstrates multidisciplinary production leadership through creative direction, visual direction, rigging, procedural animation, custom shaders, animation, pipeline coordination, and team management.
- **Regret:** Demonstrates solo execution and audience reach through a 9-minute production created at age 17 that gained over 1 million views.
